our_interpretation: The claim connects Cursor's growth to economically unsustainable service allowances and says those economics forced the June pricing changes.
The context describes growth from March through June 2025 and service changes already in effect by July 21.
Restricted access means materially less access to users' chosen models at their existing subscription price. It does not require the entire application to become unusable.
A pricing change and customer complaints alone cannot establish what caused growth or whether replacement was economically necessary.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that unsustainable service allowances materially drove growth, forced the replacement pricing, and substantially reduced chosen-model access at existing prices through poorly explained limits.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that the old allowances were economically sustainable, that the claimed causal connection was false, or that comparable model access remained available on materially unchanged terms.
